title: Only start counting at the beginning of a run

steps.caption: Longest consecutive sequence. Put everything in a set so 'is x + 1 present?' is O(1).
99 isn't in the set, so 100 starts a run. Walk up while x + 1 exists: 100..100, length 1.
3 is in the set, so 4 is in the middle of a run. Skip it: the run gets counted from its start.
199 isn't in the set, so 200 starts a run. Walk up while x + 1 exists: 200..200, length 1.
0 isn't in the set, so 1 starts a run. Walk up while x + 1 exists: 1..4, length 4.
2 is in the set, so 3 is in the middle of a run. Skip it: the run gets counted from its start.
1 is in the set, so 2 is in the middle of a run. Skip it: the run gets counted from its start.
Answer 4. Each number is walked over by at most one run, so the whole thing is O(n) despite the inner loop.
